title: Profile settings form
prompt: Build a profile settings form. It has: a text field labelled "Display name" with the hint "Shown to your crew."; a select labelled "Time zone" with three options (UTC, Berlin, Tokyo) and the placeholder "Choose a time zone"; a switch labelled "Email me about new orbits"; and a primary button "Save profile" that submits the form. After saving, show the status text "Profile saved.".
